verdict.rationale: Claude Code docs state that skills follow the Agent Skills open standard, which works across multiple AI tools. Anthropic says it published Agent Skills as an open standard for cross-platform portability, and the agentskills.io spec defines the same portable layout: a SKILL.md with required YAML frontmatter (name, description) plus optional scripts/references/assets folders, matching Anthropic's repo template. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on proof of the same skill folder running unchanged in a non-Anthropic tool, and clarity on whether Claude-specific additions (invocation-control frontmatter, plugin.json packaging) stay valid outside Claude.
